This bill is part of a package that aligns definitions in the Export Inspection and Meat Charges Collection Act 1985 with those in the Export Control Act 1982 to allow the Department of Agriculture to recover costs for export services.
The bill amends the Export Inspection (Quantity Charge) Act 1985 to fix technical defects and support equitable cost recovery.
The explanatory memorandum does not specify a start date or list the exact amendments to the Act.
Aligns definitions in the Export Inspection and Meat Charges Collection Act 1985 with the Export Control Act 1982.
Facilitates cost recovery for export services performed by the Department of Agriculture.
Remedies technical defects in the Export Inspection (Quantity Charge) Act 1985.
